why_best: Stacking crisp, semi-translucent analytical surfaces over a continuously evolving color field establishes an elegant sense of dimension that makes abstract metrics feel physical and refined.
why_bad: A rigid, high-contrast flat layout with solid backgrounds would strip away the atmospheric depth, turning a fluid creative environment into an uninspired corporate dashboard.
trap: Making the floating containers too transparent, causing the underlying color movement to bleed through so heavily that text readability is compromised.
